record.label: Plane-wave Hamiltonian for α + hydrogen
record.statement: Appendix G.1 specifies 218 electrons and one $\alpha$-particle projectile in a periodic cubic cell with 216 fixed protons. In plane-wave first quantization, each electron has integer momentum labels in $G=[-31,31]^3$. The projectile uses labels in $\tilde{G}=[-127,127]^3$ for momenta measured relative to its initial mean momentum $k_{\mathrm{proj}}$.
record.boundary: On the valid grid subspace, the Lean matrix has the kinetic and Coulomb terms of Appendix G.1. Every matrix entry with either index outside the valid grid is zero. This matrix is $H$ in the error bound for $e^{-iHt}$.
